title: PaLM Research Publication
summary: Google researchers introduced the Pathways Language Model (PaLM), a 540-billion-parameter densely activated Transformer language model, in a paper submitted to arXiv on April 5, 2022.
significance: A documented research-publication milestone for a large language model trained using Google's Pathways system.

verification.note: The arXiv record gives the submission timestamp as April 5, 2022. Google Research's publication page identifies the work as PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways and states that the authors trained a 540-billion-parameter densely activated Transformer language model called Pathways Language Model (PaLM) using Pathways. This record is intentionally classified as a research-publication milestone, not a public product-release or deployment date. No geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred.
